data.long_meaning: Aahil (أهيل) is listed in South Asian Muslim name lists with the meaning 'prince, great ruler'. The form can also be read as the Arabic diminutive of ahl (أهل), 'family', giving the sense 'little family, dear one'. Because these two explanations compete, the meaning is given at medium confidence.

faq.q: What does the name Aahil mean?
faq.a: Aahil means Prince; noble ruler (recorded); linked to ahl, family.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aahil?
What language does the name Aahil come from?
faq.a: Aahil is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aahil a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aahil is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aahil written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aahil is written أهيل in Arabic and اہیل in Urdu, and अहील in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aahil?
faq.a: The root of Aahil is أ-ه-ل (ʾ-h-l), as in ahl.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aahil?
faq.a: Recorded as 'prince'; alternatively the diminutive of Arabic ahl, 'family'.

faq.q: Does Aahil appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic name; a Muslim personal name of Arabic form.

faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aahil total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Aahil appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Ahil, Aheel.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aahil?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aahil include Aahilaan, Aahilun.

faq.q: What Arabic word is Aahil linked to?
faq.a: It is commonly linked to أهيل, either as 'prince' by convention or as the diminutive of ahl, 'family'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aahil used today?
faq.a: Aahil is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
